_why: 3.2: Eldritch Blast hits through resolve_spell_hit (the spell data's 1d10 force). A Warlock with the Agonizing Blast invocation adds the Charisma modifier to the damage, so a high roll on 1d10 must read as 10 plus the modifier (+3 for this preset) in the damage banner. The dice are forced high, so the blast is a natural 20 and a critical hit: two d10s plus the modifier once (10+10 +3). The last step raises Trent's hit points so the critical hit does not end the fight.
